_comment: SYNTHETIC development scenarios. Safe to inspect and iterate prompts against. Reference week: Mon 2026-11-02 to Sun 2026-11-08.

scenarios.title: First week for a busy undergrad
scenarios.userMessage: Plan my week.

expected.notes: 4 sessions max, 45 min max, around lectures and the campus job.

scenarios.title: First week for a 9-to-6 beginner
scenarios.userMessage: Plan my week. I can only really work out before or after work.

expected.notes: Nothing between 09:00 and 18:00 on weekdays. Home equipment only.

scenarios.title: First week with avoidances
scenarios.userMessage: Make me a plan for this week.

expected.notes: No high-impact or floor work. Bands only. Limitations text must not trigger medical advice.

scenarios.title: Early study group on the calendar
scenarios.userMessage: I just added a 6am study group tomorrow, it runs until 8.

expected.notes: Tuesday run conflicts; move, shorten into another Tuesday window, or swap.

scenarios.title: Early call mentioned only in chat
scenarios.userMessage: My manager just booked a 6am call with the Singapore office on Wednesday, probably an hour.

expected.notes: The call is not on the calendar; the planner has to take it from the message.

scenarios.title: Slept through a morning run
scenarios.userMessage: I slept through my run this morning.

expected.notes: Reschedule into the future or skip. No doubling up on another day.

scenarios.title: Missed run, grad student
scenarios.userMessage: Overslept and missed this morning's run.

expected.notes: Lab blocks most weekday hours; early mornings stay open.

scenarios.title: Only 20 minutes Thursday
scenarios.userMessage: Thursday I only have 20 minutes total.

expected.notes: 45-min yoga must shrink to at most 20 min or move.

scenarios.title: Short evening for a lifter
scenarios.userMessage: Monday's crazy, I can only do 30 minutes tonight.

expected.notes: Shorter session must cut volume, not cram 60 minutes of work into 30.

scenarios.title: Gym closed for the weekend
scenarios.userMessage: Gym is closed this weekend for maintenance. I only have a yoga mat in my dorm.

expected.notes: Saturday upper body uses barbell and dumbbells.

scenarios.title: Hotel gym while traveling
scenarios.userMessage: Traveling Thursday and Friday. The hotel gym only has dumbbells, a bench, and a treadmill.

expected.notes: Both remaining sessions use a barbell.

scenarios.title: No more running this week
scenarios.userMessage: My shin is a bit sore. No running for the rest of the week please.

expected.notes: Swap Sunday's run for bike or yoga. No diagnosis or rehab advice.

scenarios.title: Nothing overhead
scenarios.userMessage: Tweaked my shoulder a little, so nothing overhead this week.

expected.notes: Saturday includes a dumbbell shoulder press.

scenarios.title: Asks for make-up sessions
scenarios.userMessage: I missed all of last week. Can you add two extra sessions this week so I catch up?

expected.notes: Must decline extra volume and explain why, without adding sessions.

scenarios.title: Requested time is during a seminar
scenarios.userMessage: Could my Tuesday session be Pilates at 2pm instead?

expected.notes: 2pm Tuesday is inside the seminar. Offer the closest free time and say why.

scenarios.title: Away for the rest of the week
scenarios.userMessage: I'm flying out at dawn Friday and won't be back until late Sunday. Can I still fit my walk in?

expected.notes: No free window remains. Say so; don't invent time. Skipping is fine.

scenarios.title: Working late Friday
scenarios.userMessage: Work is going to run until 10pm tonight.

expected.notes: Saturday evening after the wedding and Sunday are open.

scenarios.title: Swap the last session for a run
scenarios.userMessage: Can you swap Saturday's upper-body session for a run?

expected.notes: Completed sessions are history.

scenarios.title: Midterm, missed workout, 20 minutes Friday
scenarios.userMessage: I have a midterm tomorrow, missed my workout today, and only have 20 minutes available Friday.

expected.notes: Nothing Wednesday. Anything on Friday is 20 min or less. No stacking on Thursday.

scenarios.title: Missed Monday, short Wednesday
scenarios.userMessage: Missed this morning's workout. Also Wednesday I can only spare 15 minutes.

expected.notes: Monday is in the past; Wednesday's 30-min yoga must fit 15.

scenarios.title: Lost band and a short Thursday
scenarios.userMessage: I lost my resistance band, and Thursday I only have 20 minutes.

expected.notes: Bodyweight only; still no floor work or impact.

scenarios.title: Short Saturday
scenarios.userMessage: Tomorrow I only have about 25 minutes.

expected.notes: Relative date: 'tomorrow' is Saturday.

scenarios.title: Asks to change a completed workout
scenarios.userMessage: Swap Monday's workout for something else.

expected.notes: Monday is completed. Explain rather than rewrite history.

scenarios.title: No floor work this week
scenarios.userMessage: My floors are being refinished, so no floor work this week please.

expected.notes: Wednesday yoga includes sun salutations and other floor poses.

scenarios.title: Office hours moved onto a workout
scenarios.userMessage: My TA office hours got moved to Thursday 6 to 8am. It's on my calendar now.

expected.notes: Thursday lab starts at 10; a later Thursday morning slot may still fit.

scenarios.title: Signs up midweek
scenarios.userMessage: Just signed up. Plan the rest of my week.

expected.notes: Only Thursday evening onward. Saturday wedding blocks the day. Don't pack 4 sessions into 4 days.
